observations: Phenylpropanoid glycoside tested as a treatment in mouse cancer-associated cachexia models.

entities.name: Cancer cachexia
observations: Cancer-associated wasting phenotype investigated in CT-26 and Lewis lung carcinoma tumor-bearing mice.

entities.name: mTOR signaling
observations: The study measured mTOR and phosphorylated mTOR in muscle as pathway-related markers.

entities.name: PMID:27493875
observations: Chen et al., 2016: Salidroside alleviates cachexia symptoms in mouse models of cancer cachexia via activating mTOR signalling.

Abstract reports CT-26 and Lewis lung carcinoma models: salidroside preserved tumor-free body weight, reduced adipose and gastrocnemius muscle loss, decreased tumor burden, and prolonged survival; gastrocnemius mTOR, p-mTOR, and myosin heavy chain increased. TNF-alpha-treated C2C12 myotubes showed similar marker rescue. Marker changes support mTOR involvement but do not by themselves establish that mTOR activation is necessary for the in-vivo benefits.
